item.title: PyTorch Conference 2026 Keynotes Signal Agentic AI's Rise in Core Infrastructure
item.summary: PyTorch Conference North America 2026, scheduled for October 20–21 in San Jose, announced eleven keynote speakers including representatives from the Agentic AI Foundation, Meta, Google Cloud, NVIDIA, Red Hat, and Cohere, signaling agentic AI's growing prominence in core open-source infrastructure discussions.
